whyInvest.title: Why attend?
whyInvest.intro: Discover. Connect. Invest. Partner. The Conclave 2.0 offers a focused platform to understand Madhya Pradesh's urban growth agenda and identify opportunities for participation.

items.title: Explore urban opportunities
items.summary: Discover emerging projects and opportunities across housing, infrastructure, sustainability, technology and urban development.
items.detail: The Urban Innovation Expo presents urban infrastructure projects, housing and township development, climate and sustainability initiatives, water reuse, smart governance, Simhasth 2028 opportunities, and startups.

items.title: Engage with government
items.summary: Connect with policymakers and senior government leadership shaping the State's urban development ecosystem.
items.detail: The plenary includes a special address by the Hon'ble Chief Minister. Selected participants may also be invited to an HCM one-to-one meeting. A request does not guarantee an appointment.

items.title: Understand reforms
items.summary: Gain insights into policy initiatives, regulatory reforms, digital governance and Ease of Doing Business measures.
items.detail: Sessions cover master planning, regulatory reforms, ease of approvals, GIS-based planning, building permissions and digital governance.

items.title: Build partnerships
items.summary: Explore opportunities for investment, PPPs, strategic partnerships and collaboration.
items.detail: Panel 4 looks at PPPs, project financing, municipal bonds, green bonds, multilateral financing, viability gap funding and strategic partnerships.

sectors.title: Panel Discussions
sectors.intro: Seven conversations shaping the future of urban Madhya Pradesh. Choose the conversation most relevant to your sector, expertise or investment interest.

items.title: Beyond Metros: Re-densification, TOD & TDR as Catalysts for Tier-2 Urban Growth
items.summary: Unlocking the potential of Tier-2 cities through re-densification, Transit-Oriented Development, TDR, redevelopment and growth corridors.
items.detail: Explore: Housing, Redevelopment, TOD, TDR, Master Planning, Growth Corridors and Regulatory Reforms.

items.title: Reimagining Urban Governance: Master Planning, Regulatory Reforms & Ease of Approvals
items.summary: How digital systems, planning reforms and streamlined approvals can enable faster, more efficient urban development.
items.detail: Explore: GIS-Based Planning, Digital Governance, Building Approvals, NOCs, Development Permissions and Ease of Doing Business.

items.title: Building Climate-Smart Cities: Water Security, Circular Economy & Green Urban Futures
items.summary: Exploring solutions for resilient, sustainable and liveable cities — from water security to circular economy and green infrastructure.
items.detail: Explore: Water Reuse, Water Management, Climate Resilience, Waste Management, EVs and Green Infrastructure.

items.title: Urban Financing & Investment in Madhya Pradesh: Opportunities & Reforms
items.summary: Exploring innovative pathways to finance and accelerate urban infrastructure and development projects.
items.detail: Explore: PPPs, Project Financing, Municipal Bonds, Green Bonds, Multilateral Financing, VGF and Strategic Partnerships.

items.title: Simhastha: Preparing Ujjain for the Sacred Gathering
items.summary: Urban services, crowd movement, water, sanitation and infrastructure for Simhastha in Ujjain.
items.detail: Explore: Pilgrimage infrastructure, crowd management, water and sanitation, mobility and the visitor economy.

items.title: Solar: Clean Energy for Madhya Pradesh's Cities
items.summary: Rooftop solar, green power and energy-efficient infrastructure for the state's growing cities.
items.detail: Explore: Rooftop solar, municipal energy, green buildings and clean-power partnerships.

items.title: Hackathon: Building Ideas for Smarter Cities
items.summary: Startups, students and technologists working on practical ideas for housing, mobility and city services.
items.detail: Explore: Civic technology, open data, mobility, housing and digital city services.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.intro: Messages from the leadership will be published here. The text below is a placeholder, not an official statement.

people.name: Narendra Modi
people.message: Viksit Bharat is the vision of a developed India by 2047, built through inclusive growth, modern infrastructure and opportunity in every state. Madhya Pradesh's urban journey is part of that national vision.

people.name: Dr. Mohan Yadav
people.kicker: Hon'ble Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh · Chief Guest
people.message: We are continuously working on our investment policies to create an investment friendly ecosystem. Our attempt is to combine the requirements of business world with the state's development pathway.

people.name: Kailash Vijayvargiya
people.kicker: Hon'ble Minister of Urban Development and Housing
people.message: Madhya Pradesh is opening its cities to better housing, modern infrastructure and investment. The Urban Growth Conclave is where that work meets the partners who can help build it.

agenda.title: Event agenda
agenda.intro: 28th October 2026 at the Brilliant Convention Centre, Indore. Panel discussions begin at 2:00 PM, after the plenary, HCM meetings and networking lunch.

items.detail: Until 1:30 PM. Welcome address, urban growth presentation, film presentation, industry perspective, keynote session, minister address, Chief Minister address, policy launches, investment announcements, MoU exchange and expo launch.

items.title: HCM One-to-One Meetings
items.detail: Until 2:00 PM. Meeting requests are reviewed and shortlisted by the organising committee. Submission of a request does not guarantee an appointment.

items.title: Panel Discussions
items.detail: From 2:00 PM onwards. Beyond Metros; Reimagining Urban Governance; Building Climate-Smart Cities; Urban Financing and Investment in Madhya Pradesh; Simhastha; Solar; Hackathon.

about.title: About the Conclave 2.0
paragraphs: The Department of Urban Development And Housing, Government of Madhya Pradesh, leads urban development initiatives across the state. The Madhya Pradesh Urban Growth Conclave 2.0 is its flagship urban investment and policy platform and a key milestone on the Road to GIS 2027.

The Madhya Pradesh Urban Growth Conclave 2.0 will showcase major urban projects, policy reforms, investment opportunities, MoU's, infrastructure initiatives and future-ready urban development strategies.
It brings together policymakers, investors, developers, urban experts and industry leaders. The Conclave 2.0 is on 28 October 2026 at the Brilliant Convention Centre, Indore.

Who should attend: investors, infrastructure companies, real estate developers, financial institutions, urban experts and consultants, industry associations, startups and innovators, government officials, and academia.
Key highlights: special address by the Hon'ble Chief Minister, urban policy launches, MoU exchange, Urban Innovation Expo, and HCM one-to-one meetings.

faqs.q: Does submitting the form confirm my seat?
faqs.a: No. Submission does not constitute final confirmation. Participation is subject to screening and venue capacity. Selected attendees are contacted by email about three days before the event.

faqs.q: Does an HCM meeting request guarantee an appointment?
faqs.a: No. Requests are reviewed and shortlisted by the organising committee. Selected participants receive a separate confirmation of the meeting allocation and schedule.
The plenary session and any of the seven panel discussions. You can select more than one.
Investors, developers, infrastructure companies, financial institutions, industry leaders, technology and startups, urban experts, consultants, industry associations, academia, and government.

faqs.q: How will the secretariat contact me?
faqs.a: On the email and mobile number you enter.

faqs.q: Can I check the status later?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Check status and enter the reference number together with the email used on the form.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: This is a working draft for the organising team to review with its legal adviser before publication.

The interest form collects company details, a contact person’s name, designation, official email, and mobile number, the project description, and an optional document. Email addresses and mobile numbers are stored in encrypted form.
The information is used to review the investment interest, contact the person named on the form, and produce internal reports for the investment team. It is not sold.
A confirmation message is sent to the email and mobile number you verified. A notice is also sent to the investment team inbox configured for this website.

You may ask the helpdesk, quoting your reference number, what information is held and request a correction. Access inside the admin panel is limited by role, and admin actions are written to an audit log.
Replace this draft with the policy cleared by the competent authority before the site is announced.

terms.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: This is a working draft for the organising team to review with its legal adviser before publication.
The pages on this website give general information about the Madhya Pradesh Urban Growth Conclave 2.0. They are not an offer of land, incentive, or approval.

You must give accurate information on the registration form. Filing the form does not confirm participation and does not create a right to a meeting with the Hon'ble Chief Minister, an MoU, or an allotment.
Do not upload a file you are not allowed to share. Files are scanned and may be rejected if they are not a valid PDF or DOCX within the size limit.
The organising team may update page text, dates, and documents without notice. The reference number is the record of your submission.
Replace this draft with the terms cleared by the competent authority before the site is announced.
